title: RiskOfCraft
tagline: Fight Risk of Rain 2's monsters as Steve, with Minecraft's moves, weapons, chests and the Ender Dragon.
description: Play Risk of Rain 2 as a real Minecraft player. Minecraft 26.3 runs alongside Risk of Rain 2 and the two are linked: Minecraft's movement, hotbar, hearts and weapons on Risk of Rain's stages, with your Risk of Rain items scaling Steve. Dig into the ground, open Minecraft chests on every stage, build a Nether portal to a Nether stage, and on stage 5 fight a real Ender Dragon in the End. Minecraft's rarest items wait in the Bazaar.

version.note: A Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. RiskOfCraft sets up Minecraft 26.3 itself.

downloads.name: RiskOfCraft 0.2.0
downloads.licence: MIT (RiskOfCraft; built on SkyCraft and PeakCraft, MIT). Its Minecraft bundle includes Prism Launcher (GPL-3.0) and third-party Fabric mods under their own licences

ready.message: Starting Minecraft next to Risk of Rain 2. The first time, sign in to Minecraft in the window that opens; Minecraft then downloads for a few minutes.

requirements.notes: About 3 GB of extra RAM for Minecraft and about 1.5 GB of disk for Minecraft's files.

knownIssues: Removing RiskOfCraft keeps its own copy of Minecraft and your Minecraft sign-in in your AppData folder, so reinstalling is quick.
The game can crash while closing (fixed by the creator in a later version).
